ev.q: Among 306 transgender and gender-diverse adults with hospitalization data, 21 (6.9%) were hospitalized, similar to 6.5% of cisgender adults with available data.
HIV prevalence among cisgender adults with mpox with available data was 55.1%.
466 mpox cases in transgender and gender-diverse adults were reported, accounting for 1.7% of reported cases among adults.
Most were in transgender women (43.1%) or gender-diverse persons (42.1%); 14.8% were in transgender men.
Among 306 transgender and gender-diverse adults with hospitalization data, 21 (6.9%) were hospitalized, similar to 6.5% of cisgender adults with available data.
This descriptive analysis included demographic and epidemiologic characteristics, exposure characteristics, symptoms, HIV status, and hospitalization status.

methods_quotes.q: Because of the high level of missingness of some variables, statistical testing was not performed.
Data were stratified by gender identity.
persons whose self-reported gender identity differed from their assigned sex at birth were considered transgender.
Percentages were calculated using nonmissing data.
